name: spec-to-feature
title: Spec → Production-Ready Feature Scaffold
description: Transforms a structured feature spec (T-*.md format) into a complete implementation scaffold with file structure, risk assessment, decomposed tasks, and ready-to-execute tickets.
author: SolFoundy

inputs.name: spec_path
inputs.description: Absolute path to the spec file (e.g., 'D:/project/T-CONDUCTOR-MEMORY-0.md')

inputs.name: target_dir
inputs.description: Absolute path to target directory for scaffold (e.g., 'D:/HYPERION/conductor-memory')

agents.prompt:
Read and extract structured information from the feature specification.

Spec path: {{spec_path}}
Plugin name: {{plugin_name}}
Tech stack: {{tech_stack}}

Your task:
1. Read the spec file at the provided path
2. Extract: feature title, description, DONE-WHEN criteria, dependencies, architecture notes
3. Identify key modules/components mentioned in ARCHITECTURE section
4. List any database schemas, hooks, CLI commands, or APIs described
5. Extract open questions and risks
6. Determine if this is a Node.js plugin, Python package, or other type

Return JSON:
{
  "feature_title": "",
  "feature_description": "",
  "done_when": [],
  "architecture_modules": [],
  "schemas": [{"name": "", "fields": []}],
  "hooks": [{"name": "", "trigger": "", "description": ""}],
  "cli_commands": [{"name": "", "args": "", "description": ""}],
  "apis": [{"endpoint": "", "method": "", "description": ""}],
  "dependencies": [],
  "open_questions": [],
  "risks": [],
  "plugin_type": "node-plugin|python-package|standalone"
}

Decompose the spec into atomic, testable tickets.

Feature: {{spec-reader.feature_title}}
Core files: {{scaffold-planner.core_files}}
File order: {{scaffold-planner.file_order}}
Risks: {{risk-assessor.risk_matrix}}
Phases: {{risk-assessor.phases}}
Done-when criteria: {{spec-reader.done_when}}

Your task:
1. Create 8-15 granular tickets, each deliverable in 2-4 hours of focused work
2. Each ticket must have:
   - Clear title (e.g., 'T-CONDUCTOR-MEMORY-001: Core schema and migrations')
   - DONE-WHEN: 3-5 specific, testable acceptance criteria
   - Depends-on: which tickets (if any) must complete first
   - Modified files: which files this ticket creates/modifies
   - Estimated tokens: rough estimate of LLM work needed (1k-10k)
3. Order tickets to respect dependencies (can run some in parallel)
4. Group P0/P1 risks into earlier tickets
5. Save architectural/decision tickets (design, config) early
6. Ensure final ticket(s) verify the original DONE-WHEN criteria

Return JSON array:
[
  {
    "id": "T-CONDUCTOR-MEMORY-001",
    "title": "Core schema and migrations",
    "description": "",
    "done_when": [
      "SQLite schema defined in src/schema.ts",
      "10 unit tests pass for schema validation"
    ],
    "depends_on": [],
    "modified_files": ["src/schema.ts", "tests/unit/schema.test.ts"],
    "estimated_tokens": 2000,
    "phase": 1,
    "risk_level": "P0"
  }
]

loop.exit_condition: task-decomposer returned a complete ticket array with no circular dependencies
